Evidence / VIS-POS-TRANSACTIONS
Evidence record
When was it measured or observed?Mar-2025–Jun-2026 monthly

Reported POS transactions, monthly

01What does this evidence establish?

POS transactions reported by the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) rose from 8,015 in March 2025 to 27,504 in June 2026, within CBY-Aden's reporting scope, but not steadily: the monthly high was 36,201 in May 2026. Between December 2025 (21,099) and January 2026 (24,026), the raw totals imply growth of 13.87%, while the January source graphic displays +4.9%. The May 2026 source graphic displays +9.9%, which the published totals for April 2026 (30,559) and May 2026 (36,201) do not yield; because the source contradicts itself, this resource computes no change for April to May 2026. The chart plots the reported totals, the displayed percentages are given in the chart note, and each mismatch is recorded as a discrepancy within the source.

Another view of the evidence
01What does this evidence establish?02What does it measure?03Who or what does it apply to?04How current is it?05What this evidence does not establish06Original source and verification07Method and verification detail

02What does it measure?

The monthly number of POS transactions reported by the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) within its reporting scope, March 2025 to June 2026.

03Who or what does it apply to?

POS transactions within the payment-system reporting scope of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden); how far that scope covers each area of Yemen is not established.

04How current is it?

The latest observation in this record refers to June 2026; the series runs monthly from March 2025. June 2026 was the latest monthly POS release on the Arabic payments page of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) when checked on 3 October 2026; the English payments page still listed January 2026 as the latest. The figures should not be read as describing a later period unless a newer comparable release is published.

05What this evidence does not establish

Transactions are events, not unique users or merchants, so the series does not show how many people or businesses used POS services. The monthly values are shown as published, without smoothing or interpolation, and the +4.9% displayed in the January 2026 release and the 13.87% change derived from the raw totals are not arithmetically consistent. Nor do the published April and May 2026 totals yield the +9.9% displayed in the May 2026 release; no change is computed for that month. The totals fall within the reporting scope of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) and are not shown to cover all of Yemen.

Limits of the measure

From July 2025 the monthly releases take the form of a one-page infographic; continuity of the reporting scope across that change has not been verified.

07Method and verification detail

Detail for reproducing or challenging this record without changing what it means.

How was it produced?

Monthly transaction totals as published in the monthly POS releases of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden), without smoothing or filling. The December 2025 to January 2026 change of 13.87% is derived by this resource (24,026 divided by 21,099, minus one) and is kept beside the +4.9% displayed in the January release. The May 2026 release displays +9.9%, which the published April (30,559) and May (36,201) totals do not yield; because the release contradicts itself, no April to May change is derived, and the two totals and the displayed percentage are shown as published.

When does this record change?

This record is updated when an authoritative source is revised or replaced, a newer comparable observation becomes available, the definition, population or method changes, or the conditions for public use change.

How can I verify it?

This record is drawn from the source(s) listed on this page. Open a source record to reach the original document, and check that the definition, period, population and geography match what is stated here.

How should this record be read?

Read this evidence within the definition, population or group covered, calculation base where relevant, period, geography and method shown on the page. Before reusing or comparing it, check the source, limitations, evidence date and correction history. If a value or source link is unavailable, the page says so rather than filling the gap by inference. This resource does not host source files; where an original-source link is given, check the publisher’s terms before republishing.
